interviewSignalRisks.text: Interviewer 2 note: asked to train the panel as line supervisors on a sample change, the candidate showed the new quality hold screen on the tablet, had each panel member release a sample hold themselves, pointed out the one step that differed from the old screen, and handed over a one-page card with the three steps.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify if the candidate personally conducted all 61 line sessions and if the training method was consistent with the line training standard.
